_rule: Before any model run, every eval task is run with Harbor's oracle agent. If an oracle trial does not reach reward 1 for an infrastructure or environment reason (image build failure, emulation crash, missing asset, a live website that changed or is unreachable, a grader that cannot read a correct output), the task is replaced by the first unused reserve task of the same family (families.<family>.reserve in task_subset.json, in rank order) and logged below. The replacement must reach reward 1 with the oracle as well. Upstream reference-solution bugs that agents can work around, and continuous metrics that score the oracle below 1, stay in and are reported. scripts/task_list.py applies and validates these amendments. The subset is frozen once the first model run starts; no amendments after that.

amendments.cause: Live website changed: Apple now redirects the iPhone 13/14/15 Pro Max compare URL to apple.com/, so the expected modelList can never be read. On the Mac, Chrome also timed out over CDP.

Live website changed: the oracle reaches the correct Google Shopping query, but the filter chips the grader looks for (Black, On sale, $25 - $60) are no longer on the page, so class_score is 0 for any agent.
Live websites unreachable from the task container: every tab hit 'Load timeout' and airbnb.com redirects to airbnb.com.sg, so is_expected_tabs fails for any agent. On the Mac, Chrome failed to start.
Grader cannot read a correct output: Tesseract OCR returns no text for the solution's clean, large 'ls' image, identically on the Mac (arm64 emulation) and on x86, so no agent can pass.

kept_below_reward_1.reason: Upstream reference-solution bug: solve.sh reads /tests/reference/, which Harbor uploads only after the agent finishes. Agents can still solve the task.

Upstream reference-solution bug: solve.sh applies hflip+vflip, but the gold video is a vertical flip only. The oracle output flipped horizontally matches gold (3 of 100 frames over the pHash threshold, 5 allowed), so an agent that flips vertically passes.
Continuous metric: rescaled SSIM against a reference frame; the oracle's frame differs slightly. Same on every machine.
